source_name: KU Leuven / Balgrist paired robotic + handheld lumbar spine ultrasound
what_the_pixels_are: Real human in-vivo transcutaneous lumbar B-mode ultrasound frames (TYPE A) and the physician expert bone-surface annotations for those exact frames (TYPE B). Both ship inside US/US_labels/*.zip.
licence_verified_from: Dataverse Native API record for the dataset plus DataCite rightsList (rightsIdentifier cc-by-4.0, rightsUri https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode); all 766 files report restricted=false
attribution_text: Cavalcanti NA, Li R, Arango L, Davoodi A, Van Assche K, Ao Y, Massalimova A, Salehi M, Zingg L, Gotschi T, Borghesan G, Laux CJ, Sutter R, Farshad M, Tummers M, Furnstahl P, Vander Poorten E, Carrillo F. A large, paired dataset of robotic and handheld lumbar spine ultrasound with ground-truth CT benchmarking. KU Leuven RDR, doi:10.48804/3XPCAE. Licensed CC-BY-4.0.
committed_to_public_github: selected small samples only (curated publication candidates); bulk frames are git-ignored
notes: The ONLY source in this project whose real human lumbar pixels may be redistributed. Derived overlays and prediction figures are our own derivative works over CC-BY material and carry the same attribution.

source_name: Derived assets we produced from KUL-LUMBAR
what_the_pixels_are: Overlays, contours, side-by-side panels, contact sheets, prediction and error figures rendered by tools/build_visual_library.py and tools/build_prediction_figures.py
licence_verified_from: derivative of CC-BY-4.0 source; CC-BY explicitly permits derivatives
attribution_text: Derived from Cavalcanti et al., doi:10.48804/3XPCAE, CC-BY-4.0. Segmentation predictions and error maps produced by the Lumbar_MarkAny project.
notes: Every derived asset states in its caption that the annotation is EXPERT-ANNOTATED VISIBLE BONE SURFACE, never a puncture target.

source_name: Spine Ultrasound Image Dataset (First Hospital of Putian)
what_the_pixels_are: Article figures showing real human lumbar ultrasound from 80 pregnant women in lateral position with a 2-5 MHz convex probe. The DATASET ITSELF IS NOT RELEASED.
licence: article CC BY-NC 4.0; dataset NOT released
licence_verified_from: article licence statement in PMC full text; data availability statement states the datasets are not publicly available due to patient consent agreements and ethical restrictions, requests to the corresponding author
redistribution_allowed: article figures only, NC, with attribution; dataset pixels NOT available at all
attribution_text: Lin et al. An adaptive attention U-network for recognizing ultrasound images. J Int Med Res. 2026. doi:10.1177/03000605261461196. Article licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
notes: MUST NOT be described as a public dataset. Not used as training data. No figure pixels were copied into this repository; only the citation and characterisation are recorded.

source_name: Johns Hopkins HEPIUS porcine spinal cord ultrasound
what_the_pixels_are: Porcine INTRAOPERATIVE post-laminectomy spinal cord ultrasound with 10-class masks. Not human, not lumbar, not transcutaneous.
licence_verified_from: inspected the GitHub repository (no LICENSE file, API reports license: null) and both Google Drive archives (no licence file inside)
redistribution_allowed: NO - absence of a licence is not permission
attribution_text: Kumar A, et al. A novel open-source ultrasound dataset with deep learning benchmarks for spinal cord injury localization and anatomical segmentation. PMC12475011.
notes: Used locally for exp001-exp004 (secondary methodological evidence). No pixel from this dataset is redistributed in the repository or the ZIP. Numbers computed from it are our own work and are reported freely.

source_name: Multimodal 3D ultrasound and CT in image-guided spinal surgery
what_the_pixels_are: CT plus ultrasound; the three HUMAN subjects have CT-SIMULATED ultrasound only. Real ultrasound exists solely for two ex-vivo animal phantoms.
attribution_text: Masoumi N, Belasso C, Ahmad MO, Benali H, Xiao Y, Rivaz H. Multimodal 3D ultrasound and CT in image-guided spinal surgery. Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.4813508. CC-BY-4.0.
notes: Redistributable in principle but not included: it contains no real human ultrasound, so it adds nothing to the V2 visual evidence.
